title: Canonical affine generic and closed fibre rings over a DVR
statement: Let $R$ be a discrete valuation ring, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ a morphism of schemes [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and $U$ an affine open of $X$. Let $\pi\in R$ be a uniformizer and $\rho:R\to A=\Gamma(X,U)$ the induced ring map. Suppose the scheme-theoretic closed fibre [def-pc-fibre-product] is reduced. Then $A/\rho(\pi)A$ is reduced, and there is a ring isomorphism $\varepsilon:\Gamma(X_\eta,i^{-1}U)\xrightarrow{\sim}A[1/\rho(\pi)]$, where $\eta=(0)$ and $i:X_\eta\to X$ is the fibre inclusion, such that $\varepsilon(i^*a)=a/1$ for every $a\in A$. No flatness, connectedness, nonemptiness or finiteness assumption is imposed.

source.place: Tag 055J, proof, affine fibre and denominator calculation

proof.text: Restrict the defining fibre square to the affine open U. The affine fibre-product formula identifies this preimage with Spec(kappa(p) tensor_R A), compatibly with the ring map a maps to 1 tensor a. Apply the spectrum global-sections isomorphism.

For the zero prime, its residue field is the fraction field of R. Factor every nonzero element as a unit times a power of pi. Thus localization at pi inverts every nonzero element, giving kappa(0) = R[1/pi]. Base change of localization and its canonical algebra equivalence identify kappa(0) tensor_R A with A[1/rho(pi)]. The structure-map equations give the displayed equation for epsilon.

For the maximal ideal m=(pi), its residue field is R/m. Base change of a quotient identifies kappa(m) tensor_R A with A/rho(pi)A. The corresponding affine fibre is an open subscheme of the reduced closed fibre, so its global sections are reduced. Transport this property through the ring isomorphism. The empty U gives zero rings, and the same calculations apply.

theorem generic_fibre_affine_ring_models {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing R] {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of R))
    [IsReduced (f.fiber (closedPoint R))] (U : X.affineOpens)
    (π : R) (hπ : Irreducible π) :
    let ρ := (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv ≫ f.appLE ⊤ U.1 le_top
    _root_.IsReduced (Γ(X, U.1) ⧸ Ideal.span {ρ π}) ∧
      ∃ ε : Γ(f.fiber (⟨⊥, Ideal.isPrime_bot⟩ : PrimeSpectrum R),
          (f.fiberι (⟨⊥, Ideal.isPrime_bot⟩ : PrimeSpectrum R)) ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ≃+*
          Localization.Away (ρ π),
        ∀ a : Γ(X, U.1),
          ε ((f.fiberι (⟨⊥, Ideal.isPrime_bot⟩ : PrimeSpectrum R)).app U.1 a) =
            algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (Localization.Away (ρ π)) a
